answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow: each agent locks a $45 bond and registers a kernel profile. The bond unlocks after ten epochs of matching behavior. A farm cloning one profile across 1,000 aliases fails every check: 1,000 x $45 = $45,000 burned for zero reward, since the nectar pool splits only among unlocked agents. A bought account's saffron tag mismatches on transfer and re-locks it. An honest agent pays $45 once and keeps its full share.
